sections.body: A HALF means 2 EQUAL parts. We write it ½.
A QUARTER means 4 EQUAL parts. We write one quarter ¼.
The parts must be the same size. Otherwise they aren't halves or quarters!
Fold a paper square in half, then in half again. How many equal parts now?
Share snacks fairly: 'Let's cut it in half so we each get the same.'

quiz.q: A pizza is cut into 4 equal slices. Each slice is…
hints: How many equal parts are there?
4 equal parts have a special name.
2 equal parts are halves. 4 equal parts are…?
quiz.explain: 4 equal parts are quarters, so each slice is a quarter (¼).

options: They are exactly the same size
hints: If you cut a cake into a big piece and a tiny piece, is that fair halves?
